title: Rusted Piercer
body:
"A bow so old even skeletons remember its glory days. Still deadly."

The Rusted Piercer is a Ranged weapon, it a metal bow and arrow that deals moderate damage to a singular enemy, it can be bought from the Goblin Town Shop in the Acidlands after The Arena has been defeated

Tips

-It can be an effective weapon for fighting the King Skeleton due its slow speed and the bows range and damage

-like all ranged weapons the Rusted Piercer will Automatically lock on to nearby enemies, this can be harmful when wanting to deal with a specific target
